summary: Verified new 'description from transaction notes' logic. Backend (both /api/reports/buyer-recap and /api/reports/supplier-recap) is 100% correct: descriptions now come exclusively from transaction item.note; unique non-empty notes are joined with ' • '; empty notes yield description=''; no product.description leakage; no price fields leaked. All 5 known seed cases verified (tanpa saus, Tingkat kepedasan sedang, Pedas+Manis, rasa balado, edited). Dynamically POST-ed 2 transactions with different notes on the same (buyer, product, variant) to prove the ' • ' join, plus a 3rd duplicate note to prove uniqueness — both passed. FRONTEND: Regression — SupplierRecap.jsx STILL has SKU fallback in both the tree preview (line 105) and the top 'Detail Produk' table cell (line 244). Confirmed live via Playwright: many rows now display 'SKU CIR-BAK', 'SKU LUM-COK', 'SKU: RIS-MIX' etc. instead of the required '-' dash. This directly contradicts the review's explicit requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 105 still has SKU fallback: `it.description || (it.sku ? \`SKU ${it.sku}\` : "-")`. Should be `it.description || "-"` per review. Live tree currently shows lines like 'Deskripsi : SKU LUM-COK' for items without notes.

ui_bugs.issue: Line 244 still has SKU fallback: `i.description || (i.sku ? \`SKU: ${i.sku}\` : "-")`. Should be `i.description || "-"`. Table currently shows 'SKU: CIR-BAK', 'SKU: RIS-MIX', etc. for empty-note items.

integration_issues.issue: Because treeText is used for both preview and TXT export, the SKU fallback also leaks into the exported .txt file — not byte-identical to a notes-only spec.

action_items: In /app/frontend/src/pages/SupplierRecap.jsx line 244 change the td to: `{i.description || "-"}` (drop the SKU fallback).
Optional: remove `sku` from the aggregation object since it's no longer displayed anywhere.
critical_code_review_comments: Main agent's files_of_reference claimed the frontend was already changed to `it.description || '-'`, but the actual deployed code still has the SKU fallback in BOTH places. This is a false-positive claim — please re-apply the frontend edit.
Backend supplier_recap and buyer_recap correctly build the unique-note list with ' • ' join and correctly ignore product.description. Good implementation.

Existing seed note for Jhon's Risoles Mayoo is a single stored note '1. Pedas\n2. Manis' (multiline in one line-item), so it does not go through the ' • ' path — the join was verified separately via a dynamically POST-ed 2-transaction test (TEST_BULLET_JOIN -> 'NoteAlpha • NoteBeta').
